name: user-management-microservices
description: 5 microservices: API Gateway, Registration, Login, Admin, User

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix registration-service && npm install --prefix login-service && npm install --prefix admin-service && npm install --prefix user-service
scripts.start: concurrently -n GATEWAY,REGISTER,LOGIN,ADMIN,USER -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm start --prefix api-gateway" "npm start --prefix registration-service" "npm start --prefix login-service" "npm start --prefix admin-service" "npm start --prefix user-service"
